command:
import json,sys,unittest
root=sys.argv[1]
sys.path.insert(0,root)
suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover(root+"/tests",pattern="test_*.py")
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1).run(suite)
print("AURION_LOCAL_TEST_RESULT:"+json.dumps({"tests":result.testsRun,"failures":len(result.failures),"errors":len(result.errors),"skips":len(result.skipped),"expected_failures":len(result.expectedFailures),"unexpected_successes":len(result.unexpectedSuccesses),"issues":[{"test":test.id(),"reason":reason[-2000:]} for test,reason in result.failures+result.errors+result.skipped+result.expectedFailures]}))
sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)

local_tests.scope: Fresh local Node and Python suites, including failures and skips; not native browser, Workers deployment, Windows, independent audit or hostile public network qualification.
